description: Snapshot validator (D8) with V1-V9 validation checks, determinism verifier, and fixture reconciliation. V1: schema validation. V2: reference integrity (block references, composer references). V3: evidence path existence. V4: block consistency (DOCUMENTED/IMPLEMENTED/RENDERED/VERIFIED states). V5: composer references (single Composer, no parallel). V6: dependency graph (acyclic, no missing nodes). V7: test references (test files exist). V8: evidence completeness (every claim has evidence). V9: determinism (re-run produces same hash). Fixture reconciliation compares legacy projectLlmRepositoryIntelligence.ts vs new snapshot, outputs MATCH/DISCREPANCY/UNKNOWN per claim. Depends on FEAT-001 contracts, FEAT-004 snapshot.
steps: Create src/validation/validator.ts: export interface ValidationResult { valid: boolean; errors: ValidationError[]; warnings: ValidationWarning[]; }. export interface ValidationError { code: string; message: string; path?: string; severity: 'error'; }. export interface ValidationWarning { code: string; message: string; path?: string; severity: 'warning'; }.

Create src/validation/v1-schema-validator.ts: export function validateSchema(snapshot: RepositorySnapshot): ValidationResult. Use Zod schema to validate snapshot structure. Check schemaVersion === '1.0.0'. Check required fields (repository, structure, runtime, blocks, composer, dependencies, tests, evidence, canonicalHash). Return validation errors if schema invalid.

Create src/validation/v2-reference-integrity-validator.ts: export function validateReferenceIntegrity(snapshot: RepositorySnapshot): ValidationResult. Check block references: every block in 'verified' must have corresponding entries in 'implemented' and 'rendered'. Check composer references: composer APIs must reference existing composer services. Return errors for dangling references.

Create src/validation/v3-evidence-paths-validator.ts: export function validateEvidencePaths(snapshot: RepositorySnapshot, adapter: RepositoryAdapter): Promise<ValidationResult>. For each evidence.path, call adapter.fileExists(). Return warning if path does not exist (evidence stale).

Create src/validation/v4-block-consistency-validator.ts: export function validateBlockConsistency(snapshot: RepositorySnapshot): ValidationResult. Check: (1) DOCUMENTED/IMPLEMENTED/RENDERED/VERIFIED are separate arrays (not collapsed). (2) verified blocks must be subset of implemented AND rendered. (3) No block can be in multiple states simultaneously (e.g., a block cannot be both 'planned' and 'verified'). Return errors for inconsistencies.

Create src/validation/v5-composer-validator.ts: export function validateComposer(snapshot: RepositorySnapshot): ValidationResult. Check: composer.services.length === 1 (exactly one TutorialComposerService). Return error if 0 (missing Composer) or >1 (parallel Composer detected).

Create src/validation/v6-dependency-graph-validator.ts: export function validateDependencyGraph(snapshot: RepositorySnapshot): ValidationResult. Check: (1) All dependency edges reference existing nodes. (2) Graph is acyclic (detect cycles with DFS). Return errors for missing nodes or cycles.

Create src/validation/v7-test-references-validator.ts: export function validateTestReferences(snapshot: RepositorySnapshot, adapter: RepositoryAdapter): Promise<ValidationResult>. For each test suite, check test file paths exist via adapter.fileExists(). Return warnings for missing test files.

Create src/validation/v8-evidence-completeness-validator.ts: export function validateEvidenceCompleteness(snapshot: RepositorySnapshot): ValidationResult. Check: every material claim in structure/runtime/blocks/composer has corresponding evidence entry (evidence.claim matches or evidence.path matches entity path). Return warnings for claims without evidence.

Create src/validation/v9-determinism-validator.ts: export async function validateDeterminism(repositoryRoot: string, adapter: RepositoryAdapter): Promise<ValidationResult>. Run buildSnapshot twice. Compare canonicalHash of both snapshots. Return error if hashes differ (non-deterministic).

Create src/validation/index.ts: export async function validateSnapshot(snapshot: RepositorySnapshot, adapter: RepositoryAdapter): Promise<ValidationResult>. Run all V1-V9 validators. Aggregate errors/warnings. Return combined ValidationResult.

Create src/validation/fixture-reconciliation.ts: export interface ReconciliationResult { claim: string; status: 'MATCH' | 'DISCREPANCY' | 'UNKNOWN'; legacyValue?: unknown; snapshotValue?: unknown; notes?: string; }. export async function reconcileWithLegacyFixture(snapshot: RepositorySnapshot, legacyFixturePath: string, adapter: RepositoryAdapter): Promise<ReconciliationResult[]>. Read apps/skillhubcore-admin/src/lib/project-llm/projectLlmRepositoryIntelligence.ts (parse TypeScript, extract VERIFIED_IMPLEMENTATIONS, INCOMPLETE_IMPLEMENTATIONS, PLANNED_FAMILY_IDS). Compare: (1) Legacy verified (I1, C1, D1) vs snapshot blocks.verified. (2) Legacy incomplete (S1) vs snapshot blocks (should be in 'implemented' but not 'verified'). (3) Legacy planned families (14) vs snapshot blocks.documented not in implemented. Return ReconciliationResult[] with status per claim. IMPORTANT: Do NOT make legacy win; new snapshot is source of truth. Discrepancies are informational only.
Add unit tests for each V1-V9 validator in __tests__/unit/validation/: test valid snapshot passes, test invalid snapshot produces expected errors
Add unit test __tests__/unit/fixture-reconciliation.test.ts: mock legacy fixture data, mock snapshot, assert correct MATCH/DISCREPANCY detection
Add integration test __tests__/integration/test-validation.ts: run validateSnapshot on actual buildSnapshot result, assert valid === true (or document expected warnings)
Update src/index.ts to export validateSnapshot, reconcileWithLegacyFixture
acceptance_criteria: V4 validator enforces 4 separate block states (DOCUMENTED/IMPLEMENTED/RENDERED/VERIFIED)
V5 validator confirms single Composer (no parallel Composer)
V9 validator proves determinism (same repository state -> same hash)
Fixture reconciliation compares legacy fixture vs snapshot without making legacy authoritative
ReconciliationResult outputs MATCH for I1, C1, D1 (verified), DISCREPANCY for S1 (incomplete in legacy, should be implemented but not verified in snapshot)
Unit tests achieve >80% coverage for validation module
verification: Run pnpm --filter @quiz/project-llm-discovery test and confirm all validation tests pass

Create integration test __tests__/integration/test-full-pipeline.ts: (1) build snapshot, (2) validate snapshot, (3) reconcile with legacy fixture, (4) assert validation.valid === true, (5) assert reconciliation finds 3 MATCH entries (I1, C1, D1), (6) log reconciliation results
Run integration test with tsx and confirm output shows MATCH for verified blocks
Run pnpm typecheck:all and confirm no type errors
